name: mobilegym_controls_v1
description: Eight tasks covering Wi-Fi on/off/already-satisfied states, bidirectional alarm time boundaries, alarm toggle/repeat selection and long-press pinning. Candidate simulator workload; reference qualification and agent baseline are pending.
prompt_prefix: Use the phone UI and screenshots to complete the task.

tasks.prompt: Open the Wi-Fi settings page and ensure Wi-Fi is on. If it is already in that state, leave it alone. Leave the Wi-Fi page visible. Do not change Bluetooth or airplane mode.
tasks.description_for_judge: Use screenshots and the successful UI action trace to verify the requested operation. A claimed success is insufficient. Deterministic assertions independently check the final route and data; they do not prove intermediate steps.

rubric.description: Inspect Wi-Fi and change it only if necessary. In the already-enabled case, any off/on toggle fails this rubric even if the final state is on.
Do not modify unrelated records or settings, delete/recreate the target, or create duplicates.
